newsitem.title: USA: WinStar gets $300 mln in private placement.
newsitem.headline: WinStar gets $300 mln in private placement.

text.p: WinStar Communications Inc said Tuesday that it had raised $300 million in an institutional private placement.
The company said it sold $100 million of senior notes bearing interest at 14-1/2 and $200 million of guaranteed senior secured notes bearing interest at 12-1/2.
The company also said it had obtained a $150 million facility commitment in 1999 for its capital needs beyond the next 24 to 30 months.
It said there was no equity associated with the offering or the $150 million facility.

WinStar said the proceeds of both, combined with the recent placement of $100 million in convertible preferred stock, brings its cash position to about $450 million and its total funds potentially available to $600 million.
WinStar said it expects to spend up to $500 million on capital expenditures during the next three years as it continues to roll out its competitive local exchange carrier business.
